player_prompt.intro:
Inyalo neno {N} maadhiro mamek kuom gi chache.
Katika kila hatua, tia [accept] pok gi maadhiro *mareni*, ata [continue] kataa pok gi maadhiro na neno gi achiel.
Ka inyalo kataa, inabidi pok gi maadhiro maricho.
Inyalo odhi (munde = 1) **eke** ka maadhiro pok gi chon gi neno e ma adhiro duto.

outcome.summary: Inyalo pok gi maadhiro {value} katika kuom {draw_num}/{N}. Ma adhiro duto e {best}. {result}
